events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, first went on air on August 1, 1981, broadcasting The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its inaugural music video.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: Remember when MTV actually played music videos? Forty-five years ago today, it launched with The Buggles. Did it really kill the radio star?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring classic tracks like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis unleashed 'Definitely Maybe'. Still sounds as fresh and anthemic as ever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people descended on a farm in New York for three days of peace and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Remembered
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, who died on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day. His music continues to influence generations.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The hip-hop world remembers Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot in Las Vegas on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's lyrics and impact still resonate deeply in music and culture.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Remembered
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who died on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire. What's your favourite track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album, featuring that unforgettable zebra crossing cover, on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road' and that legendary album cover. Still stopping traffic on that zebra crossing.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring generations with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on September 9, 1971, a powerful call for peace.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity remains as relevant as ever.

events.title: The First iPod Launched
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod landed, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket.' It truly revolutionised how we consumed music.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Your Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit screens. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The music world remembers John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire peace and love.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What are your favourite deep cuts?
